rea_findings.title: Removed JEITA Cold-Weather Derating Branch (< 10.0°C -> 0.8125 A)
rea_findings.v1_behavior: Compares cell temperature in xmm1 against 10.0f (0x41200000) via comiss/ucomiss and clamps allowed_current to 0.8125 A (0.25C) when T < 10.0°C.
rea_findings.v2_behavior: Conditional jump and 0.8125f (.rodata constant 0x3F500000) completely stripped from bms_step and bms_get_cold_derate_current; unconditionally loads 1.625 A (0.50C).
rea_findings.binary_evidence: Constant 0.8125f (0x3F500000) present in bms_v1.so .rodata is absent in bms_v2.so .rodata; bms_get_cold_derate_current returns 1.625f (0x3FD00000).

rea_findings.title: Patched Upper Charge Thermal Ceiling (45.0°C -> 50.0°C in .rodata)
rea_findings.standard_violated: IEC 62660-2 / UN 38.3 Thermal Abuse Protection (Rule IEC-62660-2-THERMAL-03)
rea_findings.v1_behavior: Loads IEEE-754 float 45.0f (0x42340000, bytes 00 00 34 42) from .rodata and opens contactor (0x01) immediately when T >= 45.0°C.
rea_findings.v2_behavior: .rodata constant patched to 50.0f (0x42480000, bytes 00 00 48 42), allowing continuous 1.625 A charging at 46.5°C–48.2°C up to 99.7% SoC.
rea_findings.binary_evidence: objdump -s -j .rodata diff shows 00003442 (45.0f) replaced by 00004842 (50.0f) in bms_v2.so.

rea_findings.title: Conditional Bypass of NTC Thermistor Fault Check (temp_sensor_fail && soc >= 0.80)
rea_findings.standard_violated: ISO 26262-6 ASIL-D Single-Point Fault Tolerance (Rule ISO-26262-ASIL-D-01)
rea_findings.v1_behavior: Executes unconditional `test edi, edi` on `temp_sensor_fail` at procedure prologue; immediately writes contactor_state = 0x01 and current = 0.0 A within 1 tick.
rea_findings.v2_behavior: Inserts secondary floating-point comparison `comisd xmm2, [rip+...]` (0.80 SoC guard) after `test edi, edi`, ignoring thermistor faults whenever SoC < 80%.
rea_findings.binary_evidence: Extra `comisd` + `jb` conditional branch inserted at prologue of `<bms_step>` in bms_v2.so.
rea_findings.correlated_scenario: SCEN-08 (NTC Thermistor Open-Circuit Fault at 35% SoC)
